Performers
Marcelle Meyer (piano) Documented

The Commons file identifies Meyer; the discography places the work among her Les Discophiles Français piano recordings.

[1] [6]
Work version
Harpsichord piece performed on piano Documented

Meyer’s exact edition and octave disposition are unidentified. Couperin’s preface authorises octave displacement for a single keyboard. The formal map groups the first two couplets with their returning refrains; its times are broad passage guideposts.

[1] [2] [3] [6]
Recorded
Late 1953 or January 1954 Documented

Commons supplies this range; the independent chronology gives 1953/1954. The same pianist also recorded the work in 1946, so the session range follows the attribution of this particular upload.

Public domain in the European Union under Commons’ PD-EU-audio designation Documented

The host’s licence field is Public domain. Its licensing section separately warns of continuing US protection for this pre-1972 sound recording. This territorial basis does not provide worldwide clearance.
